source: Public-safe summary of the Mac register dated 2026-11-09 and subsequent regression-test merge. Target status has not been independently revalidated.

requirements.title: Connected network safety
requirements.remaining: Capture permitted destinations and forwarding controls on the actual deployment using synthetic data.

requirements.title: Distributed inference
requirements.remaining: Run inference on two enrolled physical hosts; retain worker/device identity and exported file hashes. CUDA needs compatible hardware.

requirements.title: Distributed training
requirements.remaining: Run synchronized U-Net across two physical hosts, restart after a committed checkpoint, verify recovery and protected validation splits.

requirements.title: Windows current-user installation
requirements.remaining: Install prerequisites and app under a standard Windows account; verify launch without elevation.

requirements.title: Windows offline media
requirements.remaining: Verify USB paths, receipts/resume and launch without downloads on Windows.

requirements.title: Windows update recovery
requirements.remaining: Verify update and rollback preserve workspace on native Windows.

requirements.title: Native branding
requirements.remaining: Inspect branding in existing native installer/app on target.

requirements.title: Rotated few-shot detector
requirements.remaining: Keep in Training pending operator review; independent qualification gates remain unmet.

requirements.title: DSen2 super-resolution
requirements.remaining: Keep experimental; performance is scene-dependent and native-resolution validation remains open.

requirements.title: Additional commercial engines
requirements.remaining: Oracle 19c and unreviewed engine contracts remain pending. Existing supported Db2 contract has isolated evidence.

requirements.title: Mac desktop packaging
requirements.remaining: Native Mac web remains the current path; desktop/hybrid installer validation is deferred.

excluded_scope: Private supplier trials and custom integrations requiring supplier access.

testing.scope: Synthetic regression checks only; no physical worker, field accuracy, Windows installation, or deployment-wide traffic claim.
